correctness.rationale: For K nonnegative integer with m>0 and finite second moment and independent thinning, a 2-generation adjacent swap p<q yields conditional offspring variables B_p Bin(K,q) and B_q Bin(K,p), same mean pqK. Convexity of Bernstein polynomials gives convex-order monotonicity of their zero-end secant slopes; independent sums and further branching preserve convex order, permitting bubble-sorting any rate multiset. PGF composition implies strict terminal P(Z_h=0) if P(K>=2)>0, and the variance recurrence gives the exact stated c2 swap increment. For K supported in {0,1} thinning pgfs commute. Independent exact rational checks: 432 stop-loss inequalities for K=1,2,3 and 3 rate levels; benchmark P0 2401/4096 versus 1849/4096 and variance gap 3/8.
